text: Git branching is an important part of modern version control. A branch lets you work on new ideas without changing the main code. Developers often create feature branches to build a new function or fix a bug safely. When the work is finished, they merge the branch back into the main project. Before merging, teams usually open a pull request so others can review the changes. This workflow keeps the code stable and helps teams work together. By using branches, merging, and pull requests, developers can manage their projects in a clear and organized way.
